question: The total is 19. Which end should move?
context: The books at the two ends cost 4 and 15, and 4 + 15 = 19 is more than the voucher of 18.

choices.label: Move right inward
choices.feedback: Right. 4 is the cheapest book still in play, and even with it the 15-unit book overshoots. No remaining pair that uses 15 can work, so it is ruled out.

choices.label: Move left inward
choices.feedback: Moving left swaps 4 for a more expensive book, so the total can only stay at 19 or grow. The 15-unit book is the one that can never fit: even its cheapest partner is too much.

choices.label: Stop: no pair exists
choices.feedback: Too early. One total being too high only rules out one book, the 15-unit one. Positions 1 to 3 may still hold an answer.
